0.name: Rapid Positioning
0.desc: Move to position at maximum traverse rate. No cutting.

1.name: Linear Interpolation
1.desc: Move to position at feedrate F. Cutting move.

2.name: Circular Interpolation CW
2.desc: Clockwise arc. Use I/J/K for center or R for radius.

3.name: Circular Interpolation CCW
3.desc: Counter-clockwise arc. Use I/J/K for center or R for radius.

4.name: Dwell
4.desc: Pause for P seconds (or X seconds on some controls) at current position.

10.name: Programmable Data Input
10.desc: Set tool offsets or work offsets from program.

17.name: XY Plane Selection
17.desc: Select XY as the active plane for arcs and canned cycles.

18.name: XZ Plane Selection
18.desc: Select XZ as the active plane (lathe default).

19.name: YZ Plane Selection
19.desc: Select YZ as the active plane.

20.name: Inch Mode
20.desc: All coordinates and feed rates in inches.

21.name: Metric Mode
21.desc: All coordinates and feed rates in millimeters.

28.name: Return to Machine Home
28.desc: Rapid to reference position through optional intermediate point.

41.name: Cutter Compensation Left
41.desc: Tool path offset to the left of programmed path.

42.name: Cutter Compensation Right
42.desc: Tool path offset to the right of programmed path.

50.name: Max Spindle Speed Clamp
50.desc: Set maximum spindle speed for CSS mode (G96). Lathe: G50 Sxxxx.

53.name: Machine Coordinate System
53.desc: Next move uses machine coordinates (non-modal, single block).

70.name: Finishing Cycle (Lathe)
70.desc: Finish contour defined by G71/G72/G73 roughing.

71.name: Longitudinal Roughing (Lathe)
71.desc: Stock removal in Z direction along defined contour.

72.name: Facing Roughing (Lathe)
72.desc: Stock removal in X direction along defined contour.

31.name: Skip Function (Probe)
31.desc: Non-modal probing move: machine feeds toward target at F until probe contact is detected, then skips remaining block. Result position stored in system variables #5061–#5066.

38.2.name: Probe Toward Workpiece
38.2.desc: Feed toward target (X/Y/Z) until probe contact. Alarm if contact is NOT made before reaching target. Non-modal — does not change motion mode.

38.3.name: Probe Toward, No Alarm
38.3.desc: Feed toward target until probe contact. No alarm if contact is NOT made. Non-modal.

38.4.name: Probe Away from Workpiece
38.4.desc: Feed away from contact until probe loses contact. Alarm if contact is NOT lost before reaching target. Non-modal.

38.5.name: Probe Away, No Alarm
38.5.desc: Feed away until probe loses contact. No alarm if contact is NOT lost. Non-modal.

73.name: High-Speed Peck Drilling
73.desc: Peck drill with retract to clearance (not full retract). Parameters: Z (depth), R (retract plane), Q (peck depth), F (feed).

74.name: Left-Hand Tapping
74.desc: Tapping cycle with CCW spindle. F = S × pitch.

76.name: Thread Cutting Cycle (Lathe)
76.desc: Multi-pass threading. Two-line format: Line 1 (P/Q/R), Line 2 (X/Z/P/Q/F).

80.name: Cancel Canned Cycle
80.desc: Cancel any active canned cycle (G73-G89). Always use after last hole position.

81.name: Drill Cycle
81.desc: Simple drilling: rapid to R, feed to Z, rapid retract. Parameters: Z, R, F.

82.name: Drill with Dwell
82.desc: Drill to Z, dwell P seconds at bottom, rapid retract. Parameters: Z, R, P (dwell), F.

83.name: Peck Drilling
83.desc: Deep hole drilling with full retract pecks. Parameters: Z (depth), R (retract plane), Q (peck depth), F (feed). Q must be positive.

84.name: Rigid Tapping
84.desc: Synchronized tapping: spindle and feed locked. F must equal S × pitch. Spindle must be running (M03).

85.name: Boring Cycle (Feed Out)
85.desc: Bore to Z at feed, retract at feed. Smooth finish on bore wall.

86.name: Boring Cycle (Spindle Stop)
86.desc: Bore to Z, spindle stop at bottom, rapid retract.

88.name: Boring Cycle (Dwell, Manual)
88.desc: Bore to Z, dwell, spindle stop. Manual retract.

89.name: Boring Cycle (Dwell, Feed Out)
89.desc: Bore to Z, dwell at bottom, feed retract.

90.name: Absolute Positioning
90.desc: Coordinates are absolute from work origin.

90.1.name: Arc Center Absolute
90.1.desc: I/J/K values are absolute positions of arc center.

91.name: Incremental Positioning
91.desc: Coordinates are incremental from current position.

91.1.name: Arc Center Incremental
91.1.desc: I/J/K values are incremental from arc start (default on most controls).

94.name: Feed Per Minute
94.desc: F value is in distance per minute (IPM or mm/min).

95.name: Feed Per Revolution
95.desc: F value is in distance per spindle revolution (IPR or mm/rev).

96.name: Constant Surface Speed
96.desc: Spindle speed auto-adjusts to maintain constant SFM/m-min. Lathe. Use G50 to clamp max RPM.

97.name: Constant RPM
97.desc: Spindle runs at programmed RPM regardless of diameter.

98.name: Canned Cycle Return to Initial Plane
98.desc: After each canned cycle hole, retract to the Z height that was active when the cycle was called (safer over clamps/fixtures). Modal.

99.name: Canned Cycle Return to R Plane
99.desc: After each canned cycle hole, retract only to the R-plane (faster between closely spaced holes). Modal. Default on most controls.

187.name: HAAS Smoothing (Accuracy Control)
187.desc: Sets the motion smoothing / corner-rounding aggressiveness. P0 = off (exact stop), P1 = rough, P2 = medium, P3 = finish. E sets the corner tolerance in current units. Higher P = faster cycle time but larger corner deviation. HAAS-specific.

234.name: HAAS TCPC — Tool Center Point Control
234.desc: Activates Tool Center Point Control (TCPC) for 5-axis simultaneous machining. The control automatically compensates for rotary axis pivot offsets so the programmed XYZ path describes the tool tip position in the part coordinate system. Must be active with G254 (DWO). Cancel with G255. HAAS UMC / trunnion machines.

254.name: HAAS Dynamic Work Offset (DWO) — Activate
254.desc: Activates Dynamic Work Offset for 5-axis positioning. Rotates the active work coordinate system (G54–G59) to align with the current A/B/C axis angles, so XYZ moves remain relative to the tilted part. Use before any 5-axis positioning block. Parameter D selects which fixture/work offset to apply. Cancel with G255. HAAS UMC / trunnion 5-axis.

255.name: HAAS Dynamic Work Offset (DWO) — Cancel
255.desc: Cancels Dynamic Work Offset (G254). Returns the coordinate system to the standard non-tilted work offset. Must be called before returning to 3-axis or re-homing. HAAS UMC / trunnion 5-axis.

0.name: Program Stop
0.desc: Unconditional program stop. Press cycle start to continue.

1.name: Optional Stop
1.desc: Stop only if optional stop switch is ON.

2.name: Program End
2.desc: End program and reset to beginning.

3.name: Spindle On CW
3.desc: Start spindle clockwise at programmed S speed.

6.name: Tool Change
6.desc: Execute automatic tool change to tool T.

19.name: Spindle Orientation
19.desc: Orient spindle to a specific angle (for tool change or boring).

30.name: Program End & Reset
30.desc: End program, reset to top, rewind tape.

98.name: Subprogram Call
98.desc: Call subprogram: M98 Pxxxx (Fanuc/Haas/Mazak). Returns on M99.

99.name: Subprogram Return
99.desc: Return from subprogram to calling program.

10.name: 4th Axis Clamp
10.desc: Clamp the 4th axis (A-axis rotary table or trunnion). Use before any operation that requires the axis to be locked. Always pair with M11 (unclamp). HAAS / 4-axis machines.

11.name: 4th Axis Unclamp
11.desc: Unclamp the 4th axis (A-axis) to allow rotation. Always pair with M10 (clamp) after positioning. HAAS / 4-axis machines.

12.name: 5th Axis Clamp
12.desc: Clamp the 5th axis (B-axis trunnion tilt). Use before machining after 5-axis positioning. Always pair with M13 (unclamp). HAAS UMC trunnion machines.

13.name: 5th Axis Unclamp
13.desc: Unclamp the 5th axis (B-axis trunnion) to allow tilting. Always pair with M12 (clamp) after positioning. HAAS UMC trunnion machines.
